title: list_capabilities outputSchema
description: Structured-content shape returned by the list_capabilities tool (MCP 2025-06-18 outputSchema / structuredContent). This is an MCP-owned introspection projection of the server's composable surface (analogous to the conformance manifest), not an upstream canonical object. It lets a cold client LLM discover every tool, resource family, and grounding affordance it can compose, with the safety annotations needed to call them correctly. See taxonomy.md §Capability and grounding, §Grounding-as-Tools, and §Tool Safety Annotations.

protocolVersion.description: The negotiated MCP protocol revision the surface speaks (e.g. '2025-06-18'). See transport.md §Supported Protocol Revision.

specVersion.description: The geospatial-mcp SPEC_VERSION (taxonomy.md §Standard Version) this surface targets, e.g. '1.0'.

tools.description: The composable tool surface. Each entry is a capability descriptor sufficient for a model with no Honua-specific knowledge to call the tool.

standardName.description: The bare taxonomy.md tool name (e.g. 'resolve_entity'). Maps to a tools[].standardName in spec/schemas/index.json.

name.description: The name the server advertises on tools/list (MAY be vendor-prefixed, e.g. 'honua_resolve_entity').

workflowFamilies.description: Workflow families this tool participates in.

description.description: LLM-grade description of what the tool does and when to call it.

inputSchemaRef.description: Pointer to the tool's inputSchema (an index.json schema path or a resolvable $id).

outputSchemaRef.description: Pointer to the tool's outputSchema, when the tool declares one (MCP 2025-06-18).

example.description: Optional worked example (representative arguments) to anchor correct tool-calling.

resources.description: Advertised resource families the client can read for context. Present when includeResources is not false.

uriForm.description: The honua:// URI template for the family.

grounding.description: The grounding affordances a client LLM uses to ground entities, disambiguate, and self-check. Present when includeGrounding is not false.

tools.description: Standard names of the grounding-as-tools set (e.g. list_capabilities, resolve_entity, ground_candidates, clarify_intent, validate_plan).

resources.description: Grounding resources the model can read as evidence (e.g. honua://catalog/features). These may be catalog-family resources whose per-family inspection contract is deferred to the open-core/upstream surface in this version of the standard.

uriForm.description: honua:// URI of the grounding resource.

prompts.description: Optional reusable workflow entry points the server advertises (taxonomy.md §Prompts).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page when the surface is paginated, per the collection-read pagination contract in resources.md.

toolAnnotations.description: MCP tool safety annotations (advisory hints), aligned with the MCP base Tool.annotations. See taxonomy.md §Tool Safety Annotations.

readOnlyHint.description: True if the tool does not mutate server state. Every read-only inspection/grounding tool in this standard sets true.

destructiveHint.description: True if the tool may perform destructive updates. Read-only tools set false.

idempotentHint.description: True if repeated calls with the same arguments have no additional effect.

openWorldHint.description: True if the tool interacts with an open, evolving world (e.g. a live catalog) rather than a closed set.
